name: Kate Farms Pediatric Peptide 1.5 Formula
whyItWorks: Enzymatically hydrolyzed pea peptide formula designed for impaired digestive tracts, severe enteritis, and malabsorption. Broken-down small peptides and MCT oil absorb effortlessly in the upper jejunum without demanding pancreatic enzyme activity.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep chilled in refrigerator. Drink straight from carton or administer via enteral feeding tube as prescribed by a clinical dietitian.
